answers.en: If you have met the badge requirement but the badge is not appearing, please contact the support team so they can check your account and achievement record.
answers.or: Jadi tume badge requirement complete karichha kintu badge show heuni, support team ku contact kara. Semane tumara account au achievement record check kariparibe.
